snippet.title: LAST NOVA | In-Game Mood Teaser
snippet.description:
"When you choose power, your humanity fades."

This video is an in-game mood teaser.

We focused on the dark, dreadful atmosphere of Last Nova and the relentless fight for survival.

The game is currently in development, and your thoughts and feedback will greatly help shape our game. 

🎉 Our Steam page is now live!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489120/Last_Nova/
